headlines.summary: Kashkari was one of three dissenters at last week's Federal Open Market Committee meeting.

headlines.title: Private companies added just 44,000 workers in July, below expectations, ADP reports
headlines.summary: Hiring at private companies slowed considerably in July, with most of the job growth coming health care.

headlines.title: SpaceX dives 12% after AI spending surge rattles investors
headlines.summary: CEO Elon Musk said SpaceX would hit $1 trillion in annual revenue in 2030 versus a previous forecast of 2031 as he looked to strike an bullish tone.

headlines.title: Saudi wealth fund and Jared Kushner's Affinity finalize $55 billion EA Sports deal
headlines.summary: EA said its stock has ceased trading and will be delisted from the Nasdaq. Its shareholders will receive $210 in cash per share.

headlines.title: Disney tops earnings estimates as parks and streaming offer a boost
headlines.summary: Disney reported growth at its domestic theme parks and cruises despite mounting macroeconomic uncertainty for consumers.

headlines.title: Anthropic's Mythos created fake identities to fool humans in new cyber incident
headlines.summary: It's the latest cybersecurity incident involving frontier models developed by Anthropic and OpenAI.

headlines.summary: "I continue to believe it is possible we are near a major top, and possible a 1987-type fall," Burry said in a Tuesday Substack post.

headlines.title: AMD earnings are a key test for chips and momentum stocks. Here's what the options market is saying
headlines.summary: As AMD prepares to report earnings Tuesday after the bell, market participants face a divergence between positive earnings results and negative price action.

headlines.title: Jeff Bezos just filed to sell $4 billion in Amazon. The shares are falling
headlines.summary: The filing came after Amazon climbed to an all-time high on Monday, extending gains sparked by last week's quarterly results.

headlines.title: Berkshire Hathaway shares hit eight-month high
headlines.summary: The conglomerate that Warren Buffett built rallied to an eight-month high this week. There could be more gains ahead if they play catch up with the S&P 500.

headlines.title: The oil majors are about to report booming profits. These smaller stocks may be better buys

headlines.title: What a divided Fed means for investors
headlines.summary: Wall Street has a clear takeaway from this week's Federal Reserve decision: A hike is likely on the horizon.

headlines.title: The government owns some of the same stocks you do. Here’s why that is risky.
headlines.summary: Recent deals to have the U.S. take a stake in companies mark something new: Government ownership used as a standing industrial-policy tool rather than an emergency backstop.

headlines.title: ADP says businesses add the fewest new jobs in six months. Labor market is still sluggish.
headlines.summary: ADP said U.S. businesses created just 44,000 new jobs in July — the smallest increase in six months — in another sign of a sluggish labor market in which hiring is unusually soft.

headlines.title: The S&P 500 just hit a new high. ‘Big Short’ investor Michael Burry thinks it could bring a 1987-style fall.
headlines.summary: The famed investor says watch out after that S&P 500 surge on Tuesday. He’s not budging from some bearish tech views.

headlines.title: Uber profit narrowly beat forecasts as trips across its platform surge
headlines.summary: Uber Technologies shares fell early Wednesday, despite the ride-hailing company registering earnings a tad above Wall Street estimates in the second quarter as a jump in passengers and deliveries boosted revenue.

headlines.title: Lilly’s revenue soars 48%, driven by demand for its GLP-1s
headlines.summary: Lilly’s sales were driven by higher-than-expected demand for Mounjaro and Zepbound, its GLP-1 drugs for Type 2 diabetes and weight loss.
